description: Status checks are deliberately NOT skipped. This repo has a real test suite, so CI passing is the only thing standing between an automerged bump and a broken controller.

platformAutomerge is off so Renovate merges only once the branch is green. GitHub's own auto-merge would land the PR as soon as it is mergeable, because no branch protection marks the checks as required.

Actions are pinned to commit SHAs. A tag like v7 is mutable, so a compromised or retagged action would land in this pipeline without any config change here. Renovate keeps the SHAs current and writes the human-readable version alongside as a comment.

Base images are pinned to digests for the same reason. golang:1.27 and distroless static:nonroot are both rolling tags, so the bytes behind them change without any commit here. Pinning makes each move a reviewable PR that CI has to pass.

packageRules.description: The Kubernetes libraries are released together and will not compile apart, so update them as one PR.
These modules use 0.x versions, where a minor bump is a Kubernetes release and routinely needs code changes. Review them rather than automerging, even though CI would catch an outright break.
Action and base-image digests are safe to take unattended once CI is green.
